title: Spotlight on… Guadalajara
summary: This C40 case study describes “Spotlight on… Guadalajara,” an urban initiative documented for Guadalajara. It is included because it is located in the Global South. C40 describes the action this way: Mayor of Guadalajara, Pablo Lemus, on reclaiming streets through the pedestrianisation of the Avenida Alcalde in Guadalajara.

intervention.objectives: Mayor of Guadalajara, Pablo Lemus, on reclaiming streets through the pedestrianisation of the Avenida Alcalde in Guadalajara.
intervention.measures:
Reclaiming streets for residents is a key focus area for Mayor Pablo Lemus. The Avenida Alcalde in Guadalajara is now fully pedestrianised, which led to the creation of the Fray Antonio Alcalde promenade, the longest pedestrian walkway in Mexico at 2.5km.
